verdicts.title: On a conjecture of Montgomery-Vaughan on extreme values of automorphic L-functions at 1
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we prove a weaker form of a conjecture of Montgomery-Vaughan on extreme values of automorphic L-functions at 1.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses extreme values of automorphic L-functions at s=1 (Montgomery-Vaughan conjecture), which shares only the vocabulary 'automorphic L-functions' with the conjecture and does not engage with Boolean circuits, Frege proofs, or basis constructions in symmetric function rings.

verdicts.title: Spectral Analysis of the Zeta and L-Functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is my talk delivered at the workshop 'Automorphic L-Functions and related prpblems' (March 10--13, 2012, Tokyo University). We showed an instance of applications of the theory of automorphic representations to a genuinely traditional problem in the theory of the zeta and allied functions. We restricted ourselves to very basic issues and results, because of the purpose of the workshop.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract mentions 'automorphic L-Functions' which shares vocabulary with the conjecture, but it does not discuss Boolean circuits or Frege proof depth, and thus does not interact with the specific claim.
